title: Designing High-Performance GPU Kernels with TileLang: Tensor-Core GEMM, Fused Softmax, FlashAttention, and Autotuning
author: Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: Explore TileLang, a high-level Python domain-specific language that simplifies the design of high-performance GPU kernels. This tutorial provides a step-by-step approach to impleme...
body: TileLang, a new domain-specific language for GPU kernel compilation, has been introduced to simplify high-performance Tensor Core GEMM programming. By providing automated software pipelining and memory fusing, it allows developers to write optimized kernels with minimal boilerplate. The compiler compiles tile-level operations directly to PTX/CUDA, achieving near-hardware limits for custom operations like fused softmax and flash attention. This release enables developers to write highly performant deep learning operations without needing deep expertise in low-level GPU hardware design or manual memory indexing.
